name: George Dunlap
occupation: Photographer and business owner; he wrote that he established a photography business in 1977 and has owned numerous other businesses (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
background: In his 2024 WyoFile questionnaire, George Dunlap wrote that he had lived in Gillette all his life (67 years), was born in Gillette, and would be 67 on Election Day 2024. He wrote that he lived on a ranch south of Gillette as a child and that his grandfather and great-grandfather homesteaded the ranch in 1914.

He wrote that he established a photography business in 1977, that photography was his main profession, and that he has also owned numerous other businesses. He said he has been a member of the Rotary Club and an active member of New Life Wesleyan Church, and that he served 28 years on the Campbell County Hospital Board. He also mentioned his wife, Dawn Marie.
